meta.title: FREAKTOPIA WORLD — The world is your dancefloor
meta.description: Discover. Support. Create. Rave. A living world of music, aliens, DJs, festivals and unforgettable nights. Interactive prototype with demo data.
meta.ogDescription: THE WORLD IS YOUR DANCEFLOOR. Discover. Support. Create. Rave.

nav.searchNone: No matches. Try a city or a genre.

footer.disclaimer: Prototype. Events, DJs, venues, tickets and collectibles are fictional demo data. No payments, live streams, wallets or NFT minting are connected.
footer.label: Footer

language.label: Language
language.userContentNote: Event names, descriptions and posts stay in the language they were written in.

auth.signUpLead: Join FREAKTOPIA WORLD and get your own alien.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
auth.agree: By continuing you agree to the Terms and the Privacy policy.
auth.checkEmailBody: If {email} can be used, we've sent a link to confirm it. The link works for 24 hours.
auth.resent: If the address needs confirming, a new link is on its way.
auth.verifyFailed: This link is invalid or has expired.
auth.notVerifiedBody: We sent you a link when you signed up. Until you confirm, you can't vote in a DAO or get your alien.
auth.resetLead: Enter your email. If there's an account, we'll send a link that works for 30 minutes.
auth.resetSent: If {email} has an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.resetDone: Password changed. Every device was signed out: sign in again.
auth.unverifiedBanner: Your email isn't confirmed yet: DAO voting is off until you confirm it.
auth.walletNone: No wallet extension found in this browser.
auth.walletNote: Linking signs a message only. It never authorizes a transaction or token transfer, and it never creates a second account.
auth.demoMailboxNote: No email provider is connected, so emails are kept here instead of being sent. This only exists in demo mode.
auth.demoMailboxEmpty: No demo emails for this browser yet.
auth.googleDemoNote: DEMO: Google sign-in is not connected. This simulator stands in for Google so the flow can be tested. Nothing is sent to Google.
auth.googleNotConfigured: Google sign-in is not configured on this server.

errors.PASSWORD_WEAK: That password is too easy to guess.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email before signing in.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.CSRF: This request was blocked for your safety. Reload the page and try again.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED: Email isn't configured on this server yet.
errors.GOOGLE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Google sign-in is not configured on this server.
errors.OAUTH_STATE: Google sign-in expired. Please try again.
errors.WALLET_TAKEN: This wallet is already linked to another account.
errors.WALLET_PROOF_INVALID: The wallet signature couldn't be checked.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

verify.subject: Confirm your email for FREAKTOPIA WORLD
verify.body: Tap the link below to confirm your email. Your alien is waiting to hatch.
verify.footer: The link works for 24 hours. If you didn't sign up, ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your FREAKTOPIA WORLD password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for this account. Tap the link to choose a new one.
reset.footer: The link works once, for 30 minutes. If it wasn't you, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

resetNoAccount.subject: Password reset request for FREAKTOPIA WORLD
resetNoAccount.body: Someone asked to reset a password for this email, but there is no FREAKTOPIA WORLD account for it. You can create one here:
resetNoAccount.footer: If it wasn't you, ignore this email.

signupExisting.subject: You already have a FREAKTOPIA WORLD account
signupExisting.body: Someone tried to sign up with this email, but it already has an account. Sign in here, or reset your password if you forgot it:
signupExisting.footer: If it wasn't you, ignore this email. Nothing changed.

alien.nameLead: Your display name is shown with your alien. You can change it later.
alien.permanent: Family, colours, face and pattern are yours forever. Outfit and accessories can change any time.
alien.noReroll: There is no reroll: every alien is one of a kind.
alien.earnedNote: Crown and DAO antenna are earned through achievements and DAO membership. They never add voting power.
alien.signInToHatch: Sign up to hatch your own alien

familyBlurb.slime: Sticky grooves. Leaves a glowing trail on every dancefloor.
familyBlurb.fuzz: Pure static. Hair stands up when the bass drops.
familyBlurb.mutant: Stitched together from three different afterparties.
familyBlurb.jelly: Wobbles at 128 BPM and glows brighter as the night goes on.

profile.title: Profile
profile.notSignedIn: Sign in to see your alien, tickets and DAO memberships.
profile.cosmeticsNote: Preview only: no NFTs are minted or held.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: By default we share as little as possible. Nothing here ever shares your real location.
privacy.activityHint: Followed events, DAO memberships and achievements
privacy.mapPresence: Show my alien at events I joined on the World Map
privacy.mapPresenceHint: Only at the event's landmark, never your GPS position. Off by default.
privacy.liveAvatar: Show my alien to others at LIVE events
privacy.liveAvatarHint: When off you're still counted as a viewer, but not drawn.

hint.live: Demo simulation, not a real broadcast

world.myAlienHint: You joined this event. Only shown because you turned on World Map presence.
